IDIOM MEANING EXAMPLE GET ON THE BANDWAGON To join an activity that has become very popular. The success of the product led many firms to try to get on the bandwagon. KEEP THE CHIN UP To be stalwart and courageous in a tough situation. Don't let the difficulties intimidate you; keep your chin up. WALK OUT ON To suddenly leave a job, a relationship or other situation. Everyone was shocked when he walked out on his wife of fourteen years. COME OUT SWINGING To be confrontational. He came out swinging at his critics, accusing them of having their own agenda. BEEF UP To become big and muscular. We need to find some new players to beef up the team. TURN ASIDE To refuse entry to somewhere. His job application was turned aside when they saw his criminal record. TIDE OVER Temporary help (often financial) Have another piece of cake. It'll tide you over till supper. CRACK UP Go through an emotional breakdown. The entire group cracked up at the joke of their teacher.

entries.originalPrompt:
IDIOM MEANING EXAMPLE GIVE SOMETHING A SHOT To have a try at something. I have never eaten sushi, but I will give it a shot. HAVE A BONE TO PICK An unpleasant issue or grievance that need discussion. I have a bone to pick with you about that email. GO FOR BROKE To risk everything and go for an all out effort. If you decide to go for broke, you can’t be thinking about what will happen if you fail. MAKE A CLEAN SWEEP To remove all unwanted people or things in order to start afresh. The new leaders wanted to make a clean sweep of the discredited old order GIVE THE NOD To show one's approval of someone or something. I gave Amanda the nod because she is the most qualified candidate. HAVE AN AXE TO GRIND To have a private reason for doing or being involved in something. He has no political axe to grind. GO-TO GUY/GAL The person is frequently asked for help in that topic. Amanda’s our go-to gal for computer issues. MAKE A KILLING To earn a lot of money in a short time and with little effort. They made a killing with the sale of their London house.
